level1Intro.subject: Subject: Congratulations on completing your Computer Science degree
level1Intro.greeting: Congratulations on completing your Computer Science degree.
level1Intro.body1: The first step toward a job is the career fair. Find the recruiter who is willing to accept you and hand her your CV.
level1Intro.body2: Heads up: the guards are checking who belongs at the event. Do not let them identify you as an outsider.
level1Intro.instructions: Instructions: Submit your CV to the appropriate recruiter by pressing X, and avoid the guards. If your CV is thrown away, recover it from the trash by pressing X. Find the correct recruiter before she receives enough CVs and leaves.
level1Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level2Intro.subject: Subject: Your first technical interview
level2Intro.greeting: Congratulations on moving forward. Welcome to your first technical interview.
level2Intro.body1: Your task is to build our Binary Search Tree as completely as possible.
level2Intro.body2: For every leaf, values placed to the left must be smaller, and values placed to the right must be larger. Your score is based on how many leaves you place correctly.
level2Intro.body3: Finish before time runs out, and watch out for incoming bugs.
level2Intro.instructions: Instructions: Place each leaf in its correct Binary Search Tree position: every leaf must be left of larger values and right of smaller values. Press X to pick up and place a leaf. Move between platforms by jumping with Space. After building the tree with at least three leaves, stand by the red button and press X.
level2Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level3Intro.subject: Subject: Linked list database incident
level3Intro.body: Oh no! Our linked list has spiraled out of control and is destroying the database! Your mission is to reverse the linked list. You must jump on each node one by one to reverse its direction, starting from the Head all the way to the Tail. But be careful—it won't go down without a fight!
level3Intro.instructions: Instructions: Jump onto the snake's back with Space. Stand on the node you want to reverse and press X three times to reverse it safely.
level3Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level4Intro.subject: Subject: Technical assessment update
level4Intro.body: Congratulations on passing the technical assessments! While your performance was impressive, we currently have many strong candidates under consideration. We need to evaluate each profile and we will be in touch with you shortly. Thank you for your interest.
level4Intro.instructions: Instructions: Jump with Space and avoid obstacles. Collect Java coffee cups and press X to fire them at rival candidates.
level4Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

level5Intro.subject: Subject: Final update on your application
level5Intro.body1: Congratulations. You successfully passed every stage of our hiring process.
level5Intro.body2: However, after adopting AI across the company, we have decided not to move forward with human programmers.
level5Intro.instructions1: Your task: defeat the machine before it replaces you.
level5Intro.instructions2: Press X to fire, and avoid the artificial intelligence's electric attacks.
level5Intro.instructions: Instructions: Press X to fire at the computer. Use bonuses and destroy the power pylons to stop it.
level5Intro.continue: Press X or click to continue

finalHr.subject: Subject: Final hiring update
finalHr.body1: Congratulations on clearing every assessment in the process.
finalHr.body2: Your results outperformed every human and non-human candidate we evaluated.
finalHr.body3: Unfortunately, while you were finishing the process, the company went bankrupt. Good luck with the next job hunt.
finalHr.continue: Press X or click to continue

rejectionEmail.subject: Subject: Update on your application
rejectionEmail.body1: Thank you for the valuable time you invested in our hiring process.
rejectionEmail.body2: After a thorough review of your performance, we have decided to move forward with other candidates.
rejectionEmail.body3: We saved your resume for future opportunities, although realistically we will not contact you if a suitable position opens. Best of luck in your search.
rejectionEmail.continue: Press X or click to continue

level1.allRecruitersGone: All recruiters are done for today. Bring CV faster.
level1.noOpenTarget: No open target at the moment.
level1.acceptedNoExperience: Thank you for applying, but you still don't have enough experience.
level1.pickUpCv: Press X to collect your CV
level1.trashWarning: Oh no, they threw away your CV. Press X near the trash to recover it.
level1.guardCaught: Hey, you don't belong here. Get out.

level2.title: BST Orchard
level2.initialFeedback: Place leaves by BST rules, then submit.
level2.standNearSubmit: Stand next to the red submit button.
level2.leafLifted: Leaf lifted. Move it to a new branch.
level2.moveCloserSlot: Move closer to a leaf slot.
level2.leafPlaced: Leaf placed. Submit checks the full BST.
level2.branchOccupied: This branch already has a leaf.
level2.branchInactive: This branch is not part of the task.
level2.placeOne: Place at least 3 leaves before submitting.
level2.invalidTree: Tree is not a valid BST yet.

level3.title: Reverse Linked List Snake
level3.subtitle: Land on the glowing node and press X three times: save next, reverse, advance.
level3.interviewerTaunt1: Let's see how you handle pressure.
level3.interviewerTaunt2: In my generation, we did everything in O(1).
level3.interviewerTaunt3: Today, without AI, you can't program.

level4.title: Candidate Stack
level4.attackTaunt2: I scored higher than you in college.
level4.attackTaunt4: I already know the hiring manager.
level4.rivalFinished: We moved forward with other candidates.

level5.intro: You were the best in interviews, but the role is no longer needed because of AI.
level5.tauntProgrammersOver: The age of programmers is over.
level5.congratsShutdown: Congrats on the new job! But the company shut down.
